hero.title: Knowledge, one click away.
hero.text: Access thousands of books, theses, and scientific articles from Universite ZTF University. A digital library built for academic excellence.

search.title: Search
search.text: Quickly find your resources with our search engine by title, author, and subject.

read.title: Read
read.text: Browse high-resolution digitized books directly from your browser.

download.title: Download
download.text: Download your documents to read them offline, anytime.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Our team is available for any question regarding the library, your digital resources, or your account.
contact.formIntro: A question, a suggestion, trouble accessing a document? Write to us directly through this form, our team replies quickly.
contact.sentText: Thank you for contacting us. Our team will get back to you as soon as possible at the address provided.

login.welcome: Welcome to SCKOLARIS. Log in to your university space.

register.title: Create my account
register.subtitle: Join the Universite ZTF digital library
register.photoHint: Optional — you can add a recent ID-style photo (4x4 format).
register.photoRequired: The ID photo (4x4 format) is optional.
register.photoTooLarge: The photo exceeds the maximum allowed size (2 MB).
register.emailHint: This address must be valid and will be your primary email — you can add a secondary address later from your profile.
register.registrationNumberHint: Universite ZTF official format: enrollment year (2 digits) + program code (3 letters) + sequential number (3 digits), e.g. 26SWE001.
register.registrationNumberHintTeacher: Optional for a teacher — Universite ZTF doesn't systematically assign a registration number to teaching staff. If provided, it must still follow the official format (e.g. 26SWE001).
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a minimum of 4 letters, 3 digits and 1 symbol (order doesn't matter).
register.pendingNotice: Your registration will be validated by the library team within 24-48h. You can already browse the catalog and read online in the meantime.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your account's email address to receive a reset link, valid for 24 hours.
forgotPassword.error: Sending failed. Please try again in a moment.
forgotPassword.openInBrowser: Open the link received by email in your browser to choose a new password, then come back here to log in.

catalog.intro: Search by title, author, or subject among Universite ZTF's resources.

documentDetail.title: Document
documentDetail.syncNotice: Downloaded documents are tied to your SCKOLARIS account and sync automatically across your other devices — each keeps its own offline copy.

myLibrary.intro: The documents you've downloaded, available offline on this device.
myLibrary.empty: You haven't downloaded any documents yet. Open a document from the catalog and tap "Download" to make it available here, even offline.
myLibrary.offlineNotice: These documents remain readable even without an internet connection, on this device.

myDeposits.intro: Manage your course materials and track your deletion requests.
myDeposits.empty: You haven't deposited any course materials yet.
myDeposits.requestDeletionNotice: This action is not immediate. Your request will be submitted for an administrator's approval. The document will remain visible with the "Deletion pending" status until it is permanently removed.

myDeposits.alreadyPending: A request is already pending for this document.
myDeposits.genericError: Something went wrong, please try again.

downloads.intro: Install SCKOLARIS on your computer or Android phone to access it directly, without going through the browser.
downloads.versionRequired: Enter the version number (e.g.: 1.0.0) before publishing.
downloads.iosNotice: iOS is not distributed this way — installing an app on iPhone requires going through TestFlight (invitation link sent separately).
downloads.deleteConfirmText: Are you sure you want to delete the "{{platform}}" installer? It will no longer be offered for download until a new file is published.

hero.title: Academic Excellence at Your Fingertips
hero.text: Universite ZTF's SCKOLARIS digital library is the intellectual heart of our institution. Dedicated to supporting research, teaching, and learning, it offers seamless access to thousands of rigorously curated academic resources.

local.title: Local Roots, Global Vision
local.text: Located in Bertoua, Universite ZTF is committed to raising the level of education in the region while connecting our students to international academic standards. SCKOLARIS is the tool that removes geographic barriers, giving our researchers access to knowledge from around the world.

access.title: Accessibility
access.text: Making academic resources available 24/7 for all our students.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: Ensuring the rigor and relevance of the books and publications offered.

community.title: Community
community.text: Bringing researchers and students together around a shared learning space.
